description: This PHP source file defines the ScreenAuthorizationSubscriber class, which subscribes to kernel controller and exception events within a Symfony-based application. Its main function is to enforce access control for different screens within the OrangeHRM HR management system by intercepting controller events to verify user permissions and handle forbidden access exceptions appropriately.

classes.name: ScreenAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class that manages screen access permissions and exception handling within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of kernel events (controller and exception) that this subscriber listens to, with their corresponding handler methods.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles controller events by checking if the user has the necessary permissions to access the current module and screen, and throws a ForbiddenException if access is denied.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles ForbiddenException instances during kernel exceptions by forwarding to the ForbiddenController's handler to generate an appropriate response.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve the controller object from the controller event.
